population: Competitions exactly named IPL 2022 through IPL 2026; exact competition and match IDs.

provisional_pressure_rule.chase: required run rate >= that season's mean first-innings scoring rate and wickets remaining <= 8
provisional_pressure_rule.first_innings: at least 4 wickets lost by legal ball 60, or at least 6 by legal ball 90
provisional_pressure_rule.band: binary research flag; continuous required-rate and wickets-remaining fields retained
provisional_pressure_rule.rationale: Uses season-specific observed first-innings scoring rate as a chase benchmark and explicit resource-loss states. This is a candidate operational definition, not formally approved.

pressure_sensitivity.looser: chase required rate >=0.9 x season benchmark and wickets remaining<=8; first innings >=3 wickets before legal ball 60 or >=5 before legal ball 90
pressure_sensitivity.primary: chase required rate >=1.0 x season benchmark and wickets remaining<=8; first innings >=4 wickets before legal ball 60 or >=6 before legal ball 90
pressure_sensitivity.stricter: chase required rate >=1.25 x season benchmark and wickets remaining<=6; first innings >=5 wickets before legal ball 60 or >=7 before legal ball 90

scenarios.B1: legal balls before delivery <36 and wickets lost >=2
scenarios.B4: legal balls>=90 and two wickets fell in preceding 12 legal balls
scenarios.B5: valid chase, RRR>=season mean first-innings rate, wickets remaining<=5
scenarios.B6: B5 comparisons stratified by wickets remaining (1-3 versus 4-5)
scenarios.B7: striker batting_order<=3 and non-striker batting_order>=6, from pre-delivery lineup order
scenarios.B8: at least one wicket in preceding 12 legal balls
scenarios.B10: change in defined pressure flag from previous delivery; outcome and pre-state separately retained
scenarios.W2: bowler-credit dismissal with partnership >=20 runs before delivery
scenarios.W4: Batter innings 2 and legal balls before delivery<36
scenarios.W6: Batter innings 2 and legal balls remaining<=30

known_limits: Source run field semantics conflict with the supplied interpretation on extras rows; mismatching rows are excluded from state reconstruction.
2026 season is included exactly as present in the archive; the source snapshot date is not supplied.
B2 role is not inferred as anchor/aggressor; role is unavailable as a validated pre-event field.
Partnership and recent-wicket states are delivery reconstructed; DLS effective time is unavailable, so revised-target matches are excluded from chase classification.
Ranks are descriptive pressure-performance orderings and do not claim causal or uncertainty-adjusted player quality.
metric_definition: Versioned provisional pressure classification, scenarios, population, and known limitations.
